# SEO-579: Supply alternative text for the preview image

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| --- | --- |

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `MEDIUM` |

## Statement

Every declared preview image is accompanied by an alternative text property describing what the image shows.

## Rationale

Platforms that render the preview to readers using assistive technology have no other description of the image, so omitting it makes the preview inaccessible at the point of sharing rather than on the page.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Store the description alongside the image on the content record and emit both together, so an image without a description cannot be selected as the preview. For a generated preview image, describe what the generator draws.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Report every response declaring a preview image without an accompanying alternative text property.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `RAW_HTML`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: `og-image-alt-present`

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `SOCIAL_PREVIEW`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
